'''2014 MPC Holotable Reid Smith LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Holotable).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Holotable
